overview_description.description: Globality is a technology company that connects global companies with the best suppliers at the right price for any sourcing need across every service category. Globality is bringing digital transformation to the sourcing industry through its AI-powered Platform and Smart Sourcing technologies. Globality’s AI digital solution replaces the archaic analog Request for Proposal, efficiently and effectively scoping needs, managing demand, matching companies with outstanding suppliers that meet their specific service needs, and cutting the sourcing process from months to hours while delivering savings of 20% or more.
